entities.summary: John Pyke Hullah was an English composer and teacher of music, whose promotion of vocal training is associated with the singing-class movement. He worked with Charles Dickens and knew Felix Mendelssohn. John Pyke Hullah was a writers & intellectuals from Worcester (1812-06-27, Worcester–1884-02-21). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
